**Coaching note:** When your opponent's king and queen aren't well-coordinated, look for knight forks. Here the king on g7 and queen on e8 are vulnerable to a knight landing on e6—it checks the king while forking the queen. Always scan for forcing moves (checks, captures, threats) that hit multiple pieces.
